title: Spectral Estimates over Multiply Connected Domains
summary: We consider the quantum analogue of a disk with $n$ pairwise disjoint circular holes. We establish a uniform upper bound for the associated spectral constant that is independent of the geometry of the holes, together with a sharper asymptotic bound when the holes are well-separated. The latter generalizes recent estimates for the quantum annulus due to Crouzeix and Pascoe.
